operator_io_quirks: Tiny DB: county_public_safety 6 rows, city 17 rows; no sampling/rowid%k needed, full read is trivial.
All columns notnull=0 (nullable) despite PK; TS will not enforce NOT NULL, so NULL PKs may be attempted and fail at insert.
PK County_ID / City_ID are INT single-column PKs -> max_l0=inf, so fresh draws never capped; PK dedup via sample_fresh_primary_keys.
FK city.County_ID -> county_public_safety.County_ID, parent exists and is unique (PK); parent table is level 0, child level 1.
No composite keys, no self-references, no dangling FKs, no unique/check constraints in DDL.
Declared types INT/REAL/TEXT all dispatch to Number/String fuzzers; no crash-fallback, no Date/Time/Bool/Bit columns.
Storage classes match declared types everywhere (integer/real/text); no contradictions.
Crime_rate REAL but samples are whole numbers (118.0, 123.0) -> Number float fuzzer will perturb by +-0.01/+-0.02, producing non-integer reals.

Percentage columns (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic, Multiracial, Amerindian) are REAL in [0,100]; Number fuzzer range is [-10^scale,10^scale] with scale from REAL args (none) -> default scale, likely huge range, so values far outside [0,100].
Police_force has only 3 distinct values (RCMP, 'X Police Department'); String fuzzer will generate random charset strings, losing the 'Police Department'/'RCMP' pattern.
Location has 3 distinct (East/West/North); String fuzzer will not preserve this small enum.
Name columns are place names (Abbotsford, Adjuntas); String fuzzer random charset will not resemble them.
operator_ts_expectations: Number fuzzer on INT columns: uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] then +-1/+-2 perturbation; Population/Police_officers/Case_burden will get implausible magnitudes and negatives.
Number fuzzer on REAL columns: same range with +-0.01/+-0.02; Crime_rate and percentage columns get negatives and >100 values -> implausible.
String fuzzer on Name/Police_force/Location: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings of length 0..20, plus 50% contaminate (suffix/prefix/drop char) -> no resemblance to real names.
FK fill: city.County_ID draws with replacement from county_public_safety.County_ID final values; since parent has 6 rows and child 17, duplicates expected (many-to-one), which is correct.
PK dedup: County_ID/City_ID fresh draws from Number fuzzer over huge range -> collisions rare, so PK dedup rarely fires; but if max_l0=inf and p small, values may repeat.
No NOT NULL/CHECK enforcement: NULLs from empty parent or String None-dropout may cause insert failures counted in rows_failed.
Likely FN driver: implausible numeric magnitudes (negatives, huge) make predicates like Population > 100000 or Crime_rate < 200 trivially true/false, killing discriminating power.

Likely FP driver: String columns lose enum structure (Location East/West/North, Police_force RCMP), so GROUP BY Location / WHERE Location='East' queries get random groups; ties/duplicates in small enums not reproduced.
Percentage columns not constrained to sum ~100 or [0,100]; queries comparing White > Black or Hispanic > 90 will behave differently.
Small table sizes (6, 17) mean choose_table_sizes may produce sizes 1..2500; if size < original, joins lose rows; if larger, duplicates.
No Date/Time columns, so Date/Time fuzzer quirks (template, leading-zero strip) irrelevant here.
